tests.title: Wake Forest Undergraduate Admissions — Test Optional

test_policy.notes: SAT/ACT scores are optional and "only required if you indicate in your application that you want them considered"; self-reported scores accepted, multiple sittings are superscored. Students who wanted scores considered must send official scores in the summer before arrival.

requirements.notes: Required: $85 fee, application, official high school transcript, Secondary School Report, and one letter of recommendation from either a counselor/advisor or a teacher; Early Decision Agreement for ED I/II; TOEFL, IELTS or Duolingo for international applicants. Optional: counselor recommendation, supplemental questions, video or virtual interview, SAT/ACT, mid-year report. Fee waivers are available on request. Coalition application is listed for domestic first-year students only (international first-years use the Common App or the Wake Forest print application).

deadlines.label: Early Decision I
deadlines.notes: Binding; decisions on a rolling basis (no fixed date published).

deadlines.label: Early Action (first-generation college students only)
deadlines.notes: Non-binding; admitted students have until May 1 to decide. Open to first-generation applicants only (parents have not graduated from a four-year college).

deadlines.label: Regular Decision
deadlines.notes: Non-binding; the page says applicants hear back "around April 1" (no fixed date).

english_policy.waiver_notes: Required for international applicants whose first language is not English and/or who attend a school where English is not the medium of instruction; waived for schools where English is the main language of instruction (3 years minimum). Self-reported scores accepted; no superscoring. TOEFL iBT scores from before the January 1, 2026 format change are still accepted.

english.notes: Accepted; no minimum score is published on the page.

aid.notes: "Wake Forest University does not offer any need-based financial aid to foreign national students." International students are eligible for most merit scholarships, including full-cost awards (Carswell, Gordon, Reynolds, Stamps); the regular application doubles as the scholarship application. Applicants not given a merit award must show sufficient support on the Confidential Financial Information for International Applicants form before admission is considered. (WFU says it meets 100% of demonstrated need for domestic students.)

ielts.note: No numeric code published on the international page; it lists only ielts.org.
